api_changes: Public Recipe optimizer_family, eps and cosine beta2/reg_coeff endpoints; shared factories and caller-owned update schedules honor the same settings across Forge hosts. Defaults preserve existing recipes.
changed_factors: plain torch Adam with beta1=0, beta2 cosine 0.9 to 0.99 over the first 20% of each frozen host horizon
R1+R2 gamma cosine 1 to 0.1 over the same burn-in; penalty every discriminator update
constant network and learned-prior LR 0.0002 with equal role multipliers and eps=1e-8
disable K3P input/output noise, A2 damping, critic guard/anchor and direct-particle gain
base_declaration.hypothesis: Transfer the Modern GAN paper's Stacked MNIST training recipe to Forge's fixed toy hosts, distinguishing the complete scheduled Adam/R1/R2 recipe from the prior penalty-only swap.
base_declaration.mechanism_rationale: A substantive public optimizer and schedule change, not a seed experiment or coefficient sweep. Transfer Appendix D Table 19 Stacked MNIST training settings using completed host updates in place of processed images; 2/10 Mimg becomes 20% of the frozen host horizon. Existing toy architectures, auxiliary objectives, initialization, prior, budgets and clean/live sampling gates remain task-owned. The paper's image architecture, fixed Gaussian latent prior, 10M-image training budget and EMA image evaluation are not reproduced.

progression.policy: every declared configuration advances independently through ordinary prerequisites to the tier cap

qualification_scope: declared tuning tasks only; provisional Forge gates

selection.objective: required PASS count by ascending tuning tier (descending); configuration hash (ascending)

spec.hypothesis: The previous constant-LR 0.0085, gamma 1-to-0.1 Modern GAN configuration passed all smoke tasks but failed trajectory identity at every observation. Preserve its early transport rate and penalty schedule, then reduce later network and prior steps together; comparing equal and half-rate critics tests whether the conditional game benefits from slower critic adaptation under the same short horizons.
spec.rationale: Eight new complete shared Recipe configurations cross two cosine decay starts, two tied network/prior floors, and two discriminator role multipliers. The exact failed constant-rate configurations are excluded. Plain Adam, beta1 zero, beta2 0.9-to-0.99 over 20%, gamma 1-to-0.1 over 20%, per-update R1/R2, prior multiplier one, data/host architecture, initialization, seed, horizons, task priors and sampling remain fixed. Late decay is an optimization hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause of the historical failure. Every smoke survivor receives the same ordinary later gates while its full next-task allowance fits the frozen round budget. No per-toy settings or public-default adoption; qualification and speed remain provisional without complete coverage and calibration. The campaign ceiling is the exact eight-config worst-case task reservation, not measured cost or permission to bypass the separately frozen shared-round allowance and GPU ownership.

speed_selection.reason: No frozen comparable first-acquisition timing contract is implemented for this search. Not all required adapters record per-observation seconds; original terminal-suffix or coverage-only times cannot supply full-quality first-acquisition speed.
